authorizationNote.zh: 授权待定：iffr.com/en/disclaimer 明文禁止未经 IFFR 事先书面许可复制内容或将其公开。数据由离线快照生成（仅影片元数据与简介，不含图片/票价），raw JSON 不入库；正式上线前需取得 IFFR 书面授权。
authorizationNote.en: Authorization pending: iffr.com/en/disclaimer explicitly states it is not permitted to reproduce the Content or make it public without prior written permission from IFFR. Data generated from offline snapshots (film metadata + synopsis only; no images/prices), raw JSON not committed; written authorization from IFFR required before going live.

films.title: After the Game

films.title: Cycle (Work in Progress)

films.title: If You See a Cat
films.synopsis: Young Naoki’s grief for his beloved cat ensnares him in the machinery of psychiatric care.

films.title: The Great Escape

films.title: The Great Orator

films.title: The World Came Flooding In

films.title: 3 Scenes from a Marriage

films.title: Alterity

films.title: Preludio

films.title: Reflection 2.0

films.title: Pedra e Montanha

films.title: Cyclone

films.title: Home

films.title: Moonglow
